label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/error-message-exposure): alert-TP — User-controlled input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly into a HashMap (evt) which is then set as a request attribute ('auditEvent'). The resolved sink value is the HashMap containing user-provided data, which could expose sensitive information if the audit payload is later processed or logged improperly. This matches the rule's purpose of catching audit/exposure vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: User input param flows into evt HashMap and is set as request attribute auditEvent
